statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low during the weekend closure because no live NQ path is available.
recommendation: Tail remains below the blocking threshold; current risk is dominated by elevated cross-asset and geopolitical Stress rather than observed one-way Nasdaq structure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while energy and geopolitical Stress stays extreme
body: Friday finished with a modest Nasdaq rebound and two-sided price discovery. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no fresh extension, failed-retracement or extreme-holding evidence is available. Strait of Hormuz disruption, elevated oil and volatile long-term yields remain the principal Stress drivers.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours moved from constructive premarket conditions through an event-sensitive opening, then back to low Tail as Friday trade became two-sided and futures entered the weekend closure. Historical coverage is available for 23 of 24 hourly slots.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend futures closure. Tail stays low because live NQ path evidence is unavailable; geopolitical, oil and rates developments can alter Stress and Sunday reopening risk but are not treated as observed directional structure.
